title: Remote Supervision Options for School Quality Assurance Officers: Recommendations for a cost-effective and rapid develop-and-test process
why_not: Describes the Leh Wi Lan / SSEIP II tablets as inspection: quality assurance officers and secondary principals submit lesson observation, attendance validation and school quality forms in the Tangerine app, to Power BI dashboards; no record per learner, and nothing on primary schools' learner records.
